shadows.name: card-resting
shadows.purpose: Client card at default. Nearly invisible — signals surface, not prominence.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card on hover or keyboard focus.

shadows.name: card-selected
shadows.purpose: Active card or active sort button.

shadows.name: header
shadows.purpose: Fixed top bar — stronger to establish permanence above scrolling content.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals and dropdown menus. Neutral dark to read clearly as above-canvas.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for color/shadow state changes on cards and buttons.

motion.name: day-card-hover
motion.purpose: translateY(-5px) on day picker card hover — the one choreographed moment.

breakpoints.name: split-view
breakpoints.purpose: List + map split view activates. Below this: single-pane mobile.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Visual scaling breakpoint — font sizes, padding, touch targets, day grid columns all increase.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width CTA — city confirmation, route start. Always full-width within its container.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — GPS detect, cancel. White background, Command Blue stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; max-width: 420px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #1565C0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1565C0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; direction: rtl; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #E3F2FD; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { border-color: #90A4AE; color: #90A4AE; cursor: default; }

components.name: Sort Button
components.description: Toolbar sort/filter trigger. Four active-state variants — priority, AI-route, AI-Google, tablet-sort.
components.css: .ds-sort-btn { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid #BBDEFB; background: none; color: #546E7A; height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-sort-active-priority { color: #1565C0; border-color: #1565C0; background: #E3F2FD; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(21,101,192,.18); } .ds-sort-active-ai { color: #1B7B34; border-color: #1B7B34; background: #E8F5E9; } .ds-sort-active-google { color: #7B1FA2; border-color: #7B1FA2; background: #F3E5F5; }

components.name: City Filter Chip
components.description: City filter in route toolbar. Default and active states. Includes a client count badge.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 22px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid #90CAF9; background: #F8FBFF; color: #1565C0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; transition: all 0.15s; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); } .ds-chip:hover { background: #E3F2FD; border-color: #42A5F5; } .ds-chip.on { background: #1565C0; color: #fff; border-color: #1565C0; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(21,101,192,.3); } .ds-chip-count { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(21,101,192,.12); border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; } .ds-chip.on .ds-chip-count { background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); }

narrative.overview:
Formula Road is a precision instrument, not an interface. It exists to answer one question per glance: who is next, how far, and how well is this route going to hit target. The design must disappear into the task — a sales agent running 40 client visits on a hot Tuesday in Hadera should never think about the UI.

The system is built for the field: tablet screens tilted in passenger seats, phones mounted on dashboards, quick thumb taps between stops. Typography is bold and unambiguous; color communicates state, not decoration; touch targets accommodate gloves, sunlight, and speed.

This is not a SaaS dashboard, not a CRM, not a consumer app. It is closer in spirit to a cockpit display than a website — RTL Hebrew text, dense data rows, a three-color state vocabulary, and a map that shares the screen with a ranked client list.
keyCharacteristics: Bold, heavy type (weight 800–900) for all data labels — readable in direct sunlight
Semantic color vocabulary: blue for navigation/selection, green for success/walk-routes, red for errors/alerts, gold for targets
Flat canvas with disciplined shadow use: cards at rest are quiet; hover and selected states become visible
Touch targets 38px or taller on tablet; no small interactive areas
RTL-first layout — Hebrew is the primary reading direction

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Command Blue and its three named shades are the only colors that carry interactive states. Tertiary colors communicate data categories — they never appear on buttons, chips, or interactive surfaces outside their defined semantic roles.

rules.name: The Canvas Tint Rule
rules.body: The app background is never pure white. It carries a perceptible blue tint (#F0F5FF) that visually connects white cards to the same color family.

rules.name: The Weight-as-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: All hierarchy within a type size step is carried by weight (800 vs 400), never by introducing a new font size.

rules.name: The No-Display-Font Rule
rules.body: No decorative or display typeface is ever introduced. The system sans is the only typeface.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Client cards at default carry a barely perceptible shadow. Shadow increases only with state (hover, selected). All shadows are blue-tinted — never neutral grey.

dos: Do use weight 800–900 for any data label the agent must read at a glance in the field.
Do keep touch targets 38px or taller on tablet, 28px or taller on phone.
Do tint shadows with Command Blue on cards — never use neutral grey shadows.
Do keep the Canvas background tinted (#F0F5FF).
Do use background-tint states to communicate card state — not side stripes.
Do keep Ice Teal (#00B894) exclusive to ICE/BDD channel clients.
Do add a @media(min-width:768px) block for any new screen.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use SaaS cream or white-plus-teal enterprise dashboard aesthetics.
Don't use dark mode or neon accents.
Don't introduce a new color for a new state without documenting it in DESIGN.md.
Don't animate CSS layout properties — only transform, box-shadow, and opacity.
Don't render any UI text at less than 10px.
